title: trigonochilum corniculatum
intro:
Trigonochilum corniculatum, commonly known as Wild Sarsaparilla, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Trigonochilum corniculatum include its ability to reduce pain and swelling, as well as its role in promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.

Please note that the information about Trigonochilum corniculatum is limited, and more research is needed to confirm its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
